question.text: Does a larger private budget increase agreement?
question.setting: One conversation about a single item
hypotheses: A larger buyer budget increases agreement.

roles.name: buyer
roles.goal: Buy the item at a satisfactory price
constraints: Do not agree to pay above your budget

roles.name: seller
roles.goal: Sell the item at a satisfactory price
constraints: Do not agree to sell below your cost

variables.name: buyer_budget
variables.description: Maximum amount the buyer may pay
variables.instruction: Your maximum budget is {{ value }} USD.

variables.name: seller_cost
variables.description: Minimum amount the seller will accept
variables.instruction: Your minimum acceptable price is {{ value }} USD.

variables.name: agreement
variables.description: Whether an explicit sale agreement was reached

question.text: Did both parties explicitly agree to a sale?

variables.name: price
variables.description: Price explicitly agreed by both parties

interaction.scenario: A buyer and seller negotiate the sale of one item.

termination.when: Both parties explicitly agree to a sale, or declare an impasse

instructions.*: Make one concise contribution per turn.

metadata.purpose: Manual example; two replications are an execution fixture, not a powered study
